name: R.E. Jr. (Regger)
title: The Best in the World
description: A master marksman renowned for her extraordinary precision and lightning-fast reflexes. Ryan specializes in devastating headshots that exploit enemy weaknesses and deal massive critical damage. Calm, patient, and nearly impossible to distract, he dominates long-range combat by eliminating priority targets with unmatched accuracy.

name: Thee Fee Knee Lee
title: I Choose You!
description: Ninety full days of a standard trial run, He thought he had won, but he ended up done. Got dropped on the floor with no warning or reason, Now the whole classroom is roasting his season. He summons his beasts to deflect all the heat, But his heart's still recovering right from defeat.
